art_approval: All 27 original special-district generated artworks accepted by user before this technical batch.

reference.coordinate_system: zero-based pixel y in 707x1121 output; ordinary glyph bottom edges, descenders excluded

workflow: Accepted PNG -> bottom-only crop/padding -> single Lanczos resize to 707x1121 -> JPEG optimize/progressive/subsampling 0. No generative work, color change, separate text/ribbon movement, catalog wiring or original replacement.

cards.name: Тайное убежище

QA.title_baseline: pass: 1074–1075 using ordinary glyph black pixels, descenders excluded
QA.crop_safety: source-space boundary visually reviewed: only surplus bottom background removed, ribbon and medallion untouched
QA.visual: pass: decoded JPEG full-card contact sheets and 1:1 bottom crops inspected; complete readable title, rules, ribbon and medallion
QA.approved_painting: preserved apart from one global resize and JPEG encoding; only spare bottom background cropped or new bottom field added

limitations: A single global resize follows bottom-only crop/padding; slight vertical scale change is inherent.
Curved title baselines retain their original shape; reported baseline uses central ordinary glyphs.
No separate ribbon/text movement; no changes between rules and title.
Technical approval pending.
cards.quality_selection_method: Encode directly from prepared accepted PNG, descending integer quality from 100; choose the highest quality yielding <=300000 bytes.
cards.baseline_method: Threshold max(R,G,B)<80 within explicit ordinary-glyph ROI after connected-component inspection; excludes у/р/д/щ descenders and parchment/background. Zero-based y coordinates.
